title: High Molecular Weight Total DNA Extraction from Plant Tissues for Long Read Sequencing
author: Subash Rai
materials: Dislodge the beads by inverting the tubes.
Assess DNA quality in NanoDrop, Qubit, and TapeStation/PFGE

steps.title: Warm lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Warm 10 mL lysis buffer at 60 °C for 15–20 min.

steps.title: Prepare liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: Place ~1 L liquid nitrogen in a Dewar flask for chilling the mortar and pestle.

steps.title: Prepare dry ice
steps.instruction: Keep dry ice in an insulated container for later steps.

steps.title: Grind plant tissue
steps.instruction: In a LN₂‑chilled mortar, grind 500–1000 mg fresh or snap‑frozen tissue to a fine powder, adding LN₂ 2–3 times as needed.

steps.title: Transfer powder to tube
steps.instruction: Place a 15 mL Falcon tube on dry ice for 5 min, swirl the powder with LN₂, pour it into the tube while it remains on dry ice, and keep the lid half‑open to allow LN₂ evaporation.

steps.title: Add lysis reagents
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL pre‑warmed (60 °C) lysis buffer and 200 µL freshly added β‑mercaptoethanol to the tube.

steps.title: Mix and incubate lysis
steps.instruction: Invert the tube ~100 times until the mixture is homogeneous (white clumps are normal); then incubate at 60 °C in a thermomixer at 300 rpm for 30 min.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: After 15 min of incubation, add 200 µL Proteinase K (20 mg mL⁻¹ stock), invert 15–20 times, and continue the incubation.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Spin at 3000 × g, room temperature, 5 min; large pellets may form from clumps.

steps.title: First chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Using wide‑bore P1000 tips, transfer an equal volume of supernatant to two fresh 15 mL Falcon tubes, add an equal volume of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1), invert ~100 times until milky, then centrifuge at 3000 × g, room temperature, 10 min.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the aqueous phase to a new 15 mL Falcon tube without disturbing the interphase.

steps.title: Second chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1), invert ~100 times, and centrifuge at 3000 × g, room temperature, 10 min.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL of the aqueous phase to a 2 mL LoBind tube (multiple tubes may be used) without disturbing the interface.

steps.title: Add ammonium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL (half the volume) of 7.5 M ammonium acetate, invert to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 × g, room temperature, 10 min; resuspend the pellet in 1 mL freshly prepared 70 % ethanol using a wide‑bore tip and transfer to a 2 mL LoBind DNA tube.

steps.title: Rinse with ethanol
steps.instruction: Rinse the tube with an additional 1 mL 70 % ethanol to recover remaining CTAB‑DNA complex; repeat the rinse for the second 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Incubate ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Incubate the 2 mL tubes for 5 min at room temperature in a HulaMixer set to 9 rpm.

steps.title: Spin and discard ethanol
steps.instruction: Spin at 13 000 × g for 5 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Repeat ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Perform the incubation (step 17) and spin (step 18) once more with 2 mL of 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Air‑dry tubes
steps.instruction: Keep the tubes under a fume hood for 5 min to evaporate residual ethanol.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in TE
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA pellet in 200 µL pre‑warmed (60 °C) high‑salt TE buffer.

steps.title: RNase A digestion
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL RNase A and incubate at 37 °C for 15–20 min.

steps.title: Add ammonium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL 7.5 M ammonium acetate, mix, incubate at room temperature for 10 min, shaking once every 5 min.

steps.title: Spin and transfer
steps.instruction: Spin at 13 000 × g for 3 min and transfer the supernatant with wide‑bore tips to a fresh tube.

steps.title: Add binding buffer & beads
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of binding buffer, invert to mix, then add 150 µL bead solution (8–9 × 10⁶ beads) and incubate 30 min at room temperature in a HulaMixer.

substeps.instruction: Add binding buffer and mix by inversion.

steps.title: Magnetic bead wash 1
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a magnetic rack for 2–3 min, discard the supernatant, and wash the beads with 500 µL freshly prepared 70 % ethanol, inverting several times to dislodge clumps.

steps.title: Magnetic bead wash 2
steps.instruction: Wash the beads again with 500 µL freshly prepared 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 75 µL pre‑warmed (50 °C) 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8 elution buffer, incubate at room temperature for 15 min, then place the tube back in the magnetic rack for 5 min.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant into a fresh 1.5 mL LoBind DNA tube; if viscous, add more elution buffer or spin at 13 000 × g for 5 min.

steps.title: Post‑elution ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic rack, add 500 µL freshly prepared 70 % ethanol, return to the magnetic rack for 2 min, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a fresh 2 mL LoBind tube, add an equal volume of >98 % isopropanol, mix well, and incubate 10 min at room temperature.
